architecture.frozen: PR31 80-64-64-17 trunk, original gains and phase; no recurrent state
architecture.adapter: 64 native latent plus 16 actual-phase candidate log-amplitude deltas -> 16 bounded log-gain residuals
architecture.damping: residual min(0), target min(aligned log-envelope gain, baseline log-gain)

training.supervision: squared pre-student-clamp loggain vs teacher clamped loggain; supports corrective gradient at wrong clamp, no extreme raw-log-energy MSE
training.balance: equal supported-band mean per frame, equal EN/SV
training.selection: fixed final checkpoint; no seed or epoch search

data.augmentation: all three bitrates x both durations x both modes per clip, deterministic noise/gain cycles; EN native48 and soxr16 view per clip, SV16
data.losses: stride12, horizons 1,2,4,6; teacher state advanced with actual PR31 controls
data.teacher: SPCC1 227 f32 records; target uninterrupted decoded post-Phase1; actual-phase denominator plus PhaseWide denominator
data.acceptance: no acceptance PCM before single winner passes validation and native gates
data.reservation: neural-plc-target-energy-acceptance-reservation.json and fullband-holdout.json; inventory rechecked before opening

validation.core_slices: each cell and each cell x bitrate(12,24,32k)
validation.fine_guard: each cell x bitrate x duration x mode ESTOI >= -.001 vs each reference
validation.positive_gain: strictly positive minimum aggregate-cell ESTOI delta vs PR31
validation.ranking: guards first; greatest minimum cell ESTOI delta vs PR31; then sum cell envelope ratios; then MR ratios; then fit order and strength order

native.zero_adapter: bit-exact PCM against installed PR31 over every bitrate/duration/mode and loss patterns
native.parity: all exported strengths on 32 EN/SV fixture records, max applied-gain abs error <5e-5
native.heap: zero steady-state allocations, full core regression suite
native.pitch_optimization: None in training candidates. Four-lag trial rejected in preflight (slower); slice rewrite showed no material speedup. Original PR31 pitch search retained.
native.m5: interleaved first-loss medians <=25us and <=PR31 for each bitrate/duration/mode

outcome: retain PR31 if no admitted improvement; report failures without changing gates
